Title: Challenge: Get Beast into the Camarilla

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
There are plenty of ways to make non-cam vampires seem
like Cam vampires, or actually become them; Writ of
Acceptance, "Invitation Accepted" type votes, Clan
Impersonation...

But there's at least one vampire who is unable to
change sect as far as I can tell, and I'm wondering
if there's a clever way to do it.

Beast, Leatherface of Detroit

Is there a card I haven't seen, which allows a !Nos (or
general Sabbat vampire) to become Camarilla, without an Action or
Equipment?
Or are there any "tricks"? Such as a card that would make him
Caitiff or something?

Don't ask "Why would you want to do such a thing?"
That's not the point. I'm just wondering if it's possible.

Any ideas?

Hrm. Good challenge.

> Is there a card I haven't seen, which allows a !Nos (or

To be honest, I don't think there is.

> Or are there any "tricks"? Such as a card that would make him
> Caitiff or something?

Closest I can get is making him into a Pander with Unacceptable
Appearance.

> Don't ask "Why would you want to do such a thing?"
> That's not the point. I'm just wondering if it's possible.

As a person who takes every opportunity to exploit any loophole in the
game for the most bizarre combos possible, competitive or otherise, I
would never presume to question a man's motives in trying to do the
impossible. That's what keeps the game fun after playing it for seven
years.

That said, I can't think of a single way to do it.

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
This might be a question for LSJ..
There are ways of transferring equipment between minions, without
the receiving minion taking an action.
If another minion was somehow able to transfer a Writ of Acceptance
onto Beast, would it affect him? Would its effect count as "Using"
Equipment?

Hmm.. side question, but somewhat related:
Can an Ally carry a Writ of Acceptance, as a useless piece of
equipment? The _vampire_ carrying it is considered a Camarilla
vampire.. But does that mean that Allies can't hold onto it, even
if it has no effect?

> Hmm.. side question, but somewhat related:

> vampire.. But does that mean that Allies can't hold onto it, even

The ally can hold it, yes.

Messages.Author: rafe...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In article <9BTg6.2458$H_3.6...@typhoon.ne.mediaone.net>,

Jozxyqk <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote:
> This might be a question for LSJ..
> There are ways of transferring equipment between minions, without
> the receiving minion taking an action.
> If another minion was somehow able to transfer a Writ of Acceptance
> onto Beast, would it affect him? Would its effect count as "Using"
> Equipment?

Nope, won't work; "He [Beast] cannot have or use equipment or
retainers." The only thing I thought might work is somehow
transferring a Clan Impersonation onto Beast, since although Beast
"cannot perform action-card actions," there is no restriction on having
them on him if they can somehow be placed on him without Beast
perfoming the action himself. Unfortunately I don't think there's a
way to do this; even Succubus Club won't allow it (it transfers the
ownership of the card to another Methuselah, but the card remains on
the original minion):

"Non-equipment, non-retainer, minion cards (like Ablative skin) can be
traded, but will remain on the original minion. Control of the card
changes. Mostly this results in: "no effect" (until the controller is
ousted, of course). [LSJ 19980128] ").

However, if a card emerged which could transfer minion cards such as
CI, I think it would be legal for Beast to obtain a card in such a
manner (at least with his current card text; I suspect he may be
errata'd to remove this loophole if such a card was produced).

- Rafe
